If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days and forecast is trending up, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is trending down, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast is trending down, reverse direction by +0.5–1.0% for late horizon (16–30 days).  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is flat, add 0.5–1.0% upward bias for early horizon.  
If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast is flat, add 0.5–1.0% downward bias for mid horizon.  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is trending up, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for late horizon.
